messages:
jamie: quick async - rollout day0 update. Canary slice 2 at 5% started ~10m ago. What I did: validated feature flag gate, smoke e2e passed, metrics baseline collected. Blockers: seeing a small 99p latency bump (~80ms -> ~120ms) on kv-cache reads for slice2 that's not present in slice1. Today: triage and hold ramps. @sandeep can you sanity-check runtime logs? :eyes:

sandeep: looking now. quick grep shows p50 stable, p99 spikes correlated with requests having seq_len>1024. Not seeing GC or OOM. Possible tokenization path hitting longer sequences or a model shard alignment hiccup. Running a targeted trace on host rfc-12.

maria: thanks. can we reduce canary to 1% while you triage? also what thresholds do we use to auto-rollback? @lee

lee: agree reduce to 1%. I've queued traffic shift to 1% via gatectl; change will take ~30s. Auto-rollback triggers per runbook: error rate >0.5% sustained for 3m OR avg latency >200ms for 5m. Runbook link: https://redwoodinternal/runbooks/canary-rollout (ops). tagging oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: release v2.7.3 -> slice2 by @jamie. initial traffic: 5% -> featureFlag 'new-rerank' enabled.

sandeep: quick find: kv-cache ttl was misconfigured on slice2 nodes (ttl=0 -> effectively disabled). Enabling ttl + restarting worker on rfc-12 now. Patch ready to push to other hosts once validated.

jamie: thanks. holding any further ramps. quick CR ping: @sandeep pls review PR #4728 (runtime/kv-cache patch) — small change, low risk.

lee: if needed I can flip flag to opt-out (1% -> 0%) quickly. ping me and I'll cut traffic.

maria: heads-up to CS: small blip, will escalate if we rollback. otherwise I'll send a short note in the morning.

sandeep: restart done on rfc-12, p99 back near baseline in the last 90s. keeping canary at 1% for 15m then re-evaluate. :thumbsup:

jamie: perfect — leaving this thread open for async updates. thanks all.
